full_name: Karen Henson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Humanities Bunting Fellow Columbia University
bio: Karen Henson is an assistant professor of music at Columbia University, where her research focuses on 19th-century opera, singers and operatic performance, and opera and technology.
